Contactcard iOS
Native Swift

Contactcard

Completed
May 2023 - Jan 2024 Native iOS App

A mobile app engineered with Swift and SwiftUI that reimagines how professionals and individuals share contact credentials. Contactcard generates dynamic offline QR codes, supports bespoke digital business cards, and exports directly to Apple Contacts with zero friction.

Engineering & UX Highlights

Offline-First QR: Generate and read contact codes anywhere without internet connection.
Instant vCard Export: 1-tap direct integration with Apple Contacts & vCard standards.
Custom Card Studio: Personalized themes, logos, and dual-profile personal/work cards.
Privacy-First Storage: Secure on-device CoreData with zero third-party telemetry.

Tech Stack

iOS 16+ Swift SwiftUI CoreImage AVFoundation CoreData

kai-browser://assistant

KAI AI Browser

In Progress
Nov 2024 - Present Desktop AI Assistant

An AI-augmented browsing assistant built with Electron and React.js designed to transform productivity. KAI integrates generative AI directly into the browser viewport with live web synthesis, contextual notes, voice commands, and real-time market data tickers.

Engineering & UX Highlights

Real-Time AI Web Summarizer: Instant distilled insights from dense articles and research.
Voice Interaction: Hands-free browsing with natural multilingual voice synthesis.
Productivity Hub: Unified notes, reminders, and contextual markdown scratchpad.
Market Tickers: Live stock & cryptocurrency streaming prices embedded in sidebar.

Tech Stack

Electron.js React.js Node.js Python OpenAI API SQLite

Our R&D Methodology

How We Innovate at Graywolftek

Every project in our Innovation Lab goes through a disciplined product lifecycle, turning speculative technical concepts into reliable, production-ready systems.

PHASE 01

Discovery & Incubation

We identify bottlenecks in consumer software and emerging AI paradigms, formulating clear problem statements and UX benchmarks.

PHASE 02

Rapid Prototyping

Using modern frameworks like Swift, Electron, and TypeScript, our squads rapidly ship working alphas to validate ergonomics and performance.

PHASE 03

Hardening & Deployment

We battle-test offline resilience, query throughput, security standards, and telemetry before rolling out platforms to global users.
